nodes.description: Public token name string state variable assigned in the constructor from the tokenName argument.
Public token symbol string state variable assigned in the constructor from the tokenSymbol argument.
Public uint8 decimals fixed at 18, used to scale the initial supply.
Public total token supply, mutated by constructor, burn, burnFrom and mintToken.
Public owner address, set to msg.sender in constructor and used as the only access-control gate in mintToken.
Public mapping of address balances, written in constructor, _transfer, burn, burnFrom and mintToken.
Public nested mapping of owner=>spender=>amount approvals, written in approve and consumed in transferFrom and burnFrom.
Attacker-controlled caller address used for balances, allowances, ownership and external callback arguments.
Constructor performing unchecked initial supply multiplication and assigning balances, metadata and owner.
Payable getter function whose name permanently shadows the balanceOf state-variable mapping.
Internal transfer routine performing unchecked balance arithmetic and zero-address check.
Public transfer entrypoint moving msg.sender tokens to _to through _transfer.
Public allowance-based transfer that decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] before calling _transfer.
Public approval setting allowance[msg.sender][_spender] to an arbitrary value.
Public function that approves a spender contract and then invokes receiveApproval on it, enabling reentrancy.
Public burn of the caller's own balances, decrementing balanceOf and totalSupply without a cap.
Public burn from another account gated by allowance, decrementing balanceOf, allowance and totalSupply.
Privileged minting function gated only by msg.sender == owner that also performs two internal _transfer calls.
Unchecked multiplication initialSupply * 10 ** uint256(decimals) in the constructor can overflow totalSupply.
Unchecked subtraction/addition of balances in _transfer relying on a non-standard the require guard.
External call spender.receiveApproval(msg.sender, _value, this, _extraData) to an attacker-controlled contract with no reentrancy guard.
Unchecked decrement of totalSupply in burn and burnFrom.
require(msg.sender == owner) is the sole access-control barrier protecting mintToken; owner is a single EOA with no renunciation.
mintToken calls _transfer(0, owner, mintedAmount), a transfer from the zero address that reads balanceOf[0] and can revert or misbehave.
Constructor parameter used directly as the multiplier for the initial total supply.
Constructor parameter stored into the name state variable.
Constructor parameter stored into the symbol state variable.
Address argument used to index the balanceOf mapping.
Named return value of the balanceOf function returning the queried balance.
Source address whose balance is debited inside _transfer.
Destination address checked against 0x0 and credited inside _transfer.
Amount moved and arithmetically applied to both balances in _transfer.
Recipient of the public transfer call.
Amount forwarded from transfer into _transfer.
Owner address whose allowance and balance are spent in transferFrom.
Recipient address in transferFrom.
Amount checked against allowance and transferred in transferFrom.
Named boolean return value of transferFrom.
Spender address that becomes the key of the allowance mapping entry.
Unlimited approval amount stored for the spender.
Named boolean return value of approve.
Attacker-controlled address cast into a tokenRecipient and called externally.
Approval amount forwarded both to approve and to the external receiveApproval call.
Arbitrary bytes payload forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval callback.
Named boolean return value of approveAndCall.
Amount subtracted from the caller balance and totalSupply in burn.
Named boolean return value of burn.
Account whose balance and allowance are debited in burnFrom.
Amount burned and subtracted from totalSupply in burnFrom.
Named boolean return value of burnFrom.
Recipient address credited by mintToken before the internal _transfer calls.
Amount added to balanceOf[target] and totalSupply and passed into _transfer from the zero address.
Local tokenRecipient variable holding the cast _spender address that is externally invoked.

edges.reason: msg.sender is credited totalSupply and stored as owner in the constructor.

burnFrom reads allowance[_from][msg.sender] to authorize the burn.
mintToken authorizes minting purely on the comparison msg.sender == owner.
msg.sender is the sole operand of the owner equality check guarding mintToken.
initialSupply is multiplied by 10**decimals to compute totalSupply.
tokenName is assigned to the name state variable.
tokenSymbol is assigned to the symbol state variable.
_owner indexes the balanceOf mapping inside the getter.
balance is the named return value populated by the getter.
_from indexes the debited balance inside _transfer.
_to is checked against 0x0 and credited inside _transfer.
_value is the amount applied to the balance arithmetic.
_to is forwarded from transfer into _transfer.
_value is forwarded from transfer into _transfer.
_from keys the allowance check and the subsequent _transfer.
_to is the destination of the delegated transfer.
_value is bounded by allowance and passed to _transfer.
success is the named boolean return value of transferFrom.
_spender becomes the second key of the allowance mapping.
_value is written into the allowance mapping without limit.
success is the named boolean return value of approve.
_spender is cast into the local tokenRecipient variable spender.
The local spender variable is used inside approveAndCall's body.
_spender is passed to approve before being externally invoked.
_value is passed to approve inside approveAndCall.
_extraData is carried through approveAndCall.
success is the named boolean return value of approveAndCall.
The attacker-controlled _spender address is the target of the external receiveApproval call.
_value is handed to the external callback, allowing state to be observed and re-entered.
_extraData is forwarded as raw calldata into the untrusted external contract.
The local tokenRecipient spender is the contract invoked by spender.receiveApproval(...).
initialSupply feeds the unchecked multiplication that computes totalSupply.
decimals is exponentiated to 18 in the unchecked supply computation.
The constructor executes the multiplication without SafeMath, allowing overflow.
The overflow-prone product is written into totalSupply.
Constructor assigns balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply, concentrating all supply with the deployer.
burn._value is subtracted from totalSupply without overflow checks.
burnFrom._value is subtracted from totalSupply without overflow checks.
burn executes the unchecked totalSupply decrement.
burnFrom executes the unchecked totalSupply decrement.
The decremented value is stored back into totalSupply.
_value is subtracted and added to balances without SafeMath.
balanceOf entries are read and rewritten by the transfer arithmetic.
_transfer performs the unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value updates.
The mutated balances are written back into the balanceOf mapping.
transfer delegates all work to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom delegates the value movement to _transfer.
approveAndCall calls approve(_spender, _value) before the external callback.
approveAndCall reaches the external untrusted receiveApproval call with state already modified.
mintToken makes two internal _transfer calls, the first from the zero address.
mintToken is executed only if require(msg.sender == owner) passes.
mintToken invokes _transfer(0, owner, mintedAmount) from address zero.
mintedAmount is used both as a mint amount and as the zero-address transfer amount.
target receives mintedAmount after owner is credited from the zero address.
The untrusted tokenRecipient contract can re-enter approveAndCall or transferFrom before state settles, since balances and allowances are not locked.
